prior_separate_financing_diagnostic.scope: Superseded earlier financing archive; earlier bare-market prefix cap shows a possible baseline mechanism, not attribution of current 274 worlds. No repetition of its simulations.

methods.cap_location: abs(log(P[t]/P[t-1])) equals configured cap, rtol=0, atol=1e-12; require exact daily hit-count match
methods.depth: recur archived pricing EWMA variance/reference and depth equations from saved returns; compare saved daily cross-asset mean
methods.timing: project arrivals, next-day commitments and financing repricing precede quote; same-day firm decision/audit follows quote
methods.scheduled_arrivals: sum positive scheduled amounts whose saved due_day equals quote day; clipping can reduce realized increment
methods.event_counts: each event counted once per capped asset-day; overlapping events are not mutually exclusive
methods.inference: descriptive accounting diagnosis, no threshold changes, candidate selection, fitting or counterfactual simulations

limits: Full investor/noise holdings, raw prequote net order flow, maker inventory, transient impact and expected-flow states were not archived.
Remaining quote is a signed combined lower bound; it cannot be separated exactly into permanent, transient and inventory channels.
Executed whole-market gross volume follows final-price cash caps; it is not firm-specific signed prequote flow.
No same-day corporate news does not exclude delayed action effects through public signals, tastes, holdings or other firms.
Same-day decision/audit is after quote; coincidence does not make that day's new choice or audit the cause of its quote.
All training worlds and all three validation rules remain included, including mechanical failures and burn-in caps.

Cap asset-days are dependent: the 27 validation hits are nine seed-day-asset keys repeated across three paired rules; training tables evolve across worlds. Counts are descriptive, not IID incidence estimates.

Nine training downward caps also have commitment-cost news exceeding the cap by itself. Positive-anchor feasibility does not bound an individual expenditure news shock; these events cannot all be attributed to the order book.
Finite simulation samples and no counterfactual run cannot identify a unique root cause or justify algorithm/policy effectiveness.
